aliases: Doña Ana County AI data center
developer: STACK Infrastructure; BorderPlex Digital Assets; Oracle
status_detail: Doña Ana County approved up to $165B in IRBs and a 30-year property-tax abatement on 2025-09-19; county said construction was expected in late 2025 pending final permits/IRBs. Oracle's 2026 project page describes four data center buildings plus a warehouse across 818 acres, closed-loop non-evaporative cooling, and an on-site Bloom Energy fuel-cell microgrid. Project site reports 1,200+ workers and 1M+ hours as of April 2026.
notes: Major AI/data-center campus near Santa Teresa. Public materials emphasize economic-development benefits, PILOT/community payments, water/wastewater investment, closed-loop cooling, and privately funded infrastructure; no official MW capacity found in county/developer pages reviewed.

project_name: New Era Lea AI Data Center Hub
aliases: New Era Energy & Digital 7GW AI Data Center Hub
Lea County AI data center campus
status_detail: New Era announced on 2025-11-06 that it entered into a land-option purchase agreement for approximately 3,500 acres in Lea County for a 7GW AI data center hub. Company location page lists Lea County, New Mexico with 7+ GW planned capacity and 3,500 acres. Lea County adopted Resolution No. 26-FEB-057R approving data-center project requirements and legislative priorities on 2026-02-26.
notes: Planned energy-integrated campus; company materials describe 7+ GW planned capacity and 3,500 acres. Local reporting places the land near Caprock and says the plan includes its own gas-fired power plant plus modular nuclear component.
